name: Snow and Stories
tagline: Four full Tokyo days of anime and one big car day, a fast Kansai part from one base, then 7 nights in Hokkaido with ski-in Niseko, the drift course and Sapporo.
summary: Tokyo 4 nights: Akihabara, Ikebukuro, Nakano and a SHELTER live show, the Girls Band Cry walk in Kawasaki, and one rental-car day for Fuji, the Hakone passes and Daikoku. Then the Nozomi to Osaka for 3 nights from one Namba hotel: the Nara hill fire (Sat 23), Kyoto's Sabbat places, and the Suzuka EV kart (Mon 25). On Jan 26 you fly to New Chitose and sleep 4 nights at a ski-in hotel at Niseko Annupuri, where Pegasis teaches Aoki on the beginner runs and drives the Rusutsu snow course. The last 3 nights are in Sapporo, with Asahiyama's penguins. Only 4 hotels in 14 nights.

who.pegasis: IN (all 25 wants but 2): Daikoku with you driving (Thu night, no guide), Hakone Turnpike, Taikanzan, Otome Pass, Gotemba outlets, free City Hall view, Narita bus instead of N'EX, Isetan half-price food (night 1), Golden Gai/Omoide Yokocho, SHELTER with a live show, Nakano, Radio Kaikan, Ikebukuro goods, Maidreamin (Shibuya and Sapporo), Nara hill fire, Suzuka EV kart, Rusutsu drift (you drive), Niseko, Asahiyama penguins, Daruma, Moiwa, GARAKU. OUT: Onuma (on the Hakodate side, not on this route) and the Tokaido car road west (this plan takes the Shinkansen; only Suzuka is kept). New for your one backpack: warm layers on night 1 in Shinjuku, goggles and gloves at Gotemba, full ski rental with ski wear at Rhythm, a suitcase from Don Quijote that goes ahead to Sapporo, and 4 laundry nights.
who.aoki: IN: Omoide Yokocho, Daikoku (and Tatsumi PA if open), Lake Kawaguchi, the Eva road through Sengokuhara to Lake Ashi, Yokohama Chinatown (Cup Noodles Museum is out: it closes 18:00), Suga stairs, Shimokitazawa, SHELTER live show, Nakano, Akihabara ZEST and Radio Kaikan, Ikebukuro goods, used goods, free City Hall view, Girls Band Cry Tokyo Station dome, Hachiko and the Kawasaki walk (Miharashi, Lazona, East Exit plaza, Marufuku, CLUB CITTA') with the stamp book, Shibuya Sky before 15:00, Nintendo/Pokémon Shibuya, maid café, Don Quijote coupon, Nara fire, Fushimi Inari at dawn, Kinkakuji, Sabbat of the Witch in Kyoto, Namba food, Den Den Town, Liberty Walk, Suzuka, Niseko first ski days (Pegasis teaches you on the Family course; no ski school), Rusutsu drift ride, Daruma, Moiwa. OUT: Enoshima/Slam Dunk, Yuru Camp Motosu and the Hanz villa (only one car day, no Fuji night), Fujiten ski (Hokkaido snow is better), Fuji Motorsports Museum and Nissan Crossing (Pegasis not interested), Toyota day in Nagoya, the Kobe and Grand Front Sabbat places (the Kansai part is fast), Cape Kamui (winter path closed), Aokana/Goto (far). No onsen bathing is planned for either of you; the hotels have a bath in the room.

cost.transport: ≈ ¥105,000 per person (Narita bus, Tokyo trains, Tokyo car 24 h + tolls + fuel + parking ≈ ¥17,000, Nozomi ≈ ¥14,700, Kansai trains incl. Suzuka and Liberty Walk ≈ ¥16,000, Rapi:t, Jetstar ¥7,510 (+ Aoki's bag ≈ ¥2,500), Hokkaido 4WD 4 days + fuel ≈ ¥27,000 each, JR Asahikawa ≈ ¥10,000, airport train)
cost.hotels: ≈ ¥266,000 per person (Super Hotel Shinjuku 4 n ¥34,900; Dormy Inn Namba ANNEX 3 n ≈ ¥40,000; Niseko Northern Resort 4 n with dinner + breakfast ¥151,900; Route-Inn Sapporo 3 n ¥39,200). Budget option: Hotel 3M Kutchan instead of Northern Resort saves about ¥100,000 per person
cost.activities: Pegasis ≈ ¥130,000 (ski rental 3 days with wear ≈ ¥41,000, lifts ≈ ¥29,000, drift ride + 30-min drive ¥39,500, Suzuka, Shibuya Sky, SHELTER, maid cafés, temples, Moiwa, zoo, Shikotsu) · Aoki ≈ ¥80,000 (same rental, lifts ≈ ¥15,000, drift ride ¥8,500, the rest similar; no lessons)
cost.total: Pegasis ≈ ¥500,000 + his clothes, gear, suitcase and parcel ≈ ¥45,000–65,000 · Aoki ≈ ¥450,000 · both plus food ≈ ¥50,000 outside the 4 hotel dinners; excl. international flights

flights: Pegasis: open-jaw about CA$1,247 (drafts, Sep 2026). Out: WestJet Toronto 09:35 Mon Jan 18 → Calgary → Narita 16:30 Tue Jan 19 (backpack only: no checked bag needed). Home: Air Canada New Chitose 19:35 Tue Feb 2 → Vancouver → Toronto 19:57 same day (Google Flights, Sep 26, 2026: ¥80,050 one way). Checked bag home: Air Canada's allowance depends on the fare type; check it in the baggage calculator when you book, and choose a fare with 1 checked bag for the suitcase (not checked here; if a fee applies, budget about CA$100).

Aoki: in: Spring Airlines Shanghai Pudong 15:00 → Narita 18:40 Tue Jan 19 (Google Flights, Sep 26, 2026: ¥32,840). Home: Spring Airlines New Chitose 13:50 → Shanghai Pudong 17:00 Tue Feb 2, nonstop (¥83,340, Chinese New Year prices; Feb 1 is ¥46,950). Book early.
Osaka → Hokkaido: Jetstar Kansai 09:50 → New Chitose 11:50, Tue Jan 26 (Google Flights, Sep 26, 2026: ¥7,510; + checked bag about ¥2,500 for Aoki). Backup: Peach Kansai 09:15 → 11:10 (¥10,150).

bookFirst.what: Niseko Northern Resort An'nupuri, Jan 26–30, deluxe twin, dinner + breakfast (冬期早割60)
bookFirst.why: book now: Jalan showed '1 room left' on Sep 26, and the early-bird 60 price ends about Nov 27. Niseko is almost full for late January.

bookFirst.what: All flights: Pegasis's open-jaw (with 1 checked bag home), Aoki's Spring Airlines both ways, Jetstar KIX → CTS on Jan 26
bookFirst.why: book by mid-October, because Chinese New Year pushes Aoki's Feb 2 fare up and the ¥7,510 Jetstar fare will not last.

bookFirst.what: Hotels: Super Hotel Shinjuku Kabukicho (Jan 19–23), Dormy Inn PREMIUM Namba ANNEX (Jan 23–26), Route-Inn Sapporo Ekimae Kitaguchi (Jan 30–Feb 2)
bookFirst.why: book by mid-October, because the Nara fire Saturday fills Osaka and the Sapporo twin plans showed '1 room left'.

bookFirst.what: Toyota Rent a Car Shinjuku-sanchome, Thu Jan 21 08:00 → Fri Jan 22 08:00, compact with studless tyres + ETC
bookFirst.why: book by early December, because Tokyo shops have few cars with winter tyres.

bookFirst.what: Toyota Rent a Car New Chitose → Sapporo-ekimae, Jan 26–30, 4WD
bookFirst.why: book by early December, because 4WD cars at CTS sell out in peak ski season.

bookFirst.what: Rusutsu snow drift: email about Pegasis's 1-year licence + IDP now; book the Thu Jan 28 10:00 slot
bookFirst.why: book by early January, because slots are few and the answer on the licence decides if Pegasis drives or only rides.

bookFirst.what: SHELTER show ticket (Wed Jan 20) and Suzuka EV kart (Mon Jan 25, Asoview)
bookFirst.why: book in early December, because the SHELTER list and the kart calendar both come out in December and good slots go fast.

bookFirst.what: Rhythm ski rental for both (3 days, skis + boots + poles + helmet + jacket + pants)
bookFirst.why: book online at least 48 h before Jan 26 (10% off); do it in early January so your sizes are in stock.

bookFirst.what: Shibuya Sky web ticket, Fri Jan 22, 14:40 slot
bookFirst.why: book on about Jan 8 (tickets open 2 weeks ahead), because the before-15:00 slots are cheaper and sell out.

bookFirst.what: Email Route-Inn Sapporo Ekimae Kitaguchi to accept Pegasis's suitcase parcel (arrives about Jan 25)
bookFirst.why: ask by Jan 15, because the hotel must agree to keep a guest parcel 5 days before check-in.

places.blurb: Both of you land here on Tue Jan 19. Pegasis lands first (WestJet 16:30) and goes ahead to Shinjuku to buy winter clothes; Aoki lands at 18:40 (Spring Airlines).

info.label: To Tokyo
info.value: Airport Bus TYO-NRT to Tokyo Station, ¥1,500, about 70–80 min

tips: Check which terminal each flight uses. A free shuttle bus runs between the terminals.
Pegasis: while you wait, buy two Welcome Suica cards and eat something. Register both of you in Visit Japan Web before the flights.
The ¥1,500 bus needs no booking. Late-night buses cost ¥3,000, so take one before about 22:00.

places.ja: 東京駅 丸の内南口ドーム
places.blurb: The round brick hall where Nina arrives in Tokyo in Girls Band Cry episode 1. The airport bus stops at Tokyo Station, so it costs only 10 minutes.

info.label: From the bus stop
info.value: Walk through the station to the Marunouchi side, 5–8 min

tips: Look up at the dome ceiling: eagles and the Chinese zodiac animals.

places.ja: スーパーホテル新宿歌舞伎町
places.blurb: A good-value business hotel in Kabukicho, 7 minutes from Shinjuku Station, with a free breakfast buffet. You sleep here 4 nights, Jan 19–22.

info.label: Room
info.value: Economy twin (two 90 cm beds) with breakfast

info.label: Price
info.value: ¥69,800 for 4 nights, 2 people (Jalan, vacancy seen Sep 26, 2026) = about ¥34,900 per person

info.label: Laundry
info.value: No washer in the hotel: 24 h coin laundry 150 m away

tips: Book on Jalan or the official site with the free Smart Membership: about ¥500 back per night.
The room is small. Pegasis: keep the new suitcase closed under the bed.
Kabukicho is noisy at night: ask for a high floor.

places.ja: 伊勢丹新宿店 デパ地下
places.blurb: The department store food hall. In the last hour before it closes at 20:00, sushi and bento get 30–50% stickers.
tips: Pegasis: buy a light dinner here on the first evening; the yakitori with Aoki comes later.

places.ja: ユニクロ 新宿本店
places.blurb: A big UNIQLO in the old Bicqlo building at Shinjuku-sanchome, with GU in the same building. Pegasis buys all his warm layers here on the first evening.

info.label: Buy (rough prices)
info.value: HEATTECH top ¥1,500–3,000 ×2, HEATTECH tights ¥1,500–3,000, down jacket ¥6,000–15,000, gloves ¥1,500, knit hat ¥1,500, neck warmer ¥1,500, thick socks ¥600

tips: Buy HEATTECH 'Extra Warm' for Hokkaido (−10 °C in Niseko).
Wear the new down jacket out of the shop: the backpack stays light.

places.en: MEGA Don Quijote Shinjuku East Exit
places.ja: MEGAドン・キホーテ 新宿東口本店
places.blurb: A 24-hour discount store 3 minutes from UNIQLO. Pegasis buys the small winter things and a cheap suitcase here, so every souvenir from Tokyo can go straight into it.

info.label: Buy (rough prices)
info.value: Heat packs (カイロ) 10 pcs ¥400–700, ice grips for shoes (靴用滑り止め) ¥1,000–2,000, toothbrush and toiletries ¥1,000, hard-shell suitcase ¥5,000–10,000

info.label: Coupon
info.value: Show the visitor coupon on your phone and your passport: tax-free + coupon

tips: Buy a medium suitcase (about 60–65 cm). A large one costs more to send and may pass 23 kg on the flight home.
Aoki: Chinese plugs with angled pins do not fit Japanese sockets. A travel adapter is about ¥500–1,000 here. Canadian plugs fit without an adapter.

places.blurb: A narrow alley of tiny yakitori bars beside the Shinjuku tracks. Good for a late first dinner after the flights.
tips: Many bars have a seat charge (お通し) of ¥300–500. This is normal.
If one bar is full, walk on: there are about 80. Golden Gai is 10 min away for another night.

places.blurb: The red-railed stairs from the last scene of Your Name. Early morning is quiet.
tips: Stand at the bottom and shoot up the stairs for the film angle.
It is a residential street: keep your voice low.

places.en: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building, free observatory
places.blurb: A free deck 202 m above Nishi-Shinjuku. On clear winter mornings you see Mt Fuji.
tips: Jan 20 is a Wednesday, so the south deck is open.

places.blurb: 10 floors of figures, cards, model kits and anime goods opposite Akihabara Station.

info.label: Also
info.value: Akihabara ZEST (Oshi no Ko 'BEAST') is a 3 min walk north

tips: Ignore maids handing out flyers on the street; go to a real maid café.

places.en: Ikebukuro anime goods street (Animate, Surugaya, K-BOOKS)
places.blurb: Chinese fans now call Ikebukuro the best place for anime goods. Start at the 9-floor Animate main store, then used goods at Surugaya and Lashinbang, then the row of K-BOOKS shops.

info.label: Tax-free
info.value: ¥5,000+ before tax per shop, same day

tips: Keep all receipts from one shop together for the tax refund at the airport.
Eat lunch here: many ramen shops on Sunshine 60-dori.

places.blurb: A 1960s shopping building. Floors 2–4 are full of used figures, cards and old toys, with many Mandarake shops.
tips: Go after 13:00: small shops open late.
Many shops do not allow photos.

places.blurb: The town of Bocchi the Rock!: live houses, used-clothes shops and small cafés. Walk the Bocchi spots before dark.

info.label: Bocchi spots
info.value: Honda Theater, Donguri Hiroba park, Senrogai lot

tips: Take the SHELTER stairs photo in daylight: the live house asks for no photos on show nights.
Eat dinner here before the show: soup curry is the local dish.

places.blurb: The basement live house that is the model for STARRY in Bocchi the Rock!. Tonight you go inside for a real indie rock show.

info.label: Schedule
info.value: loft-prj.co.jp, the Jan 2027 list comes out in Dec 2026

tips: Buy the ticket in December. If the site needs a Japanese phone number, pick the ticket up at a 7-Eleven or FamilyMart.
Bring ¥600 in coins for the drink ticket. Standing only.

places.ja: トヨタレンタカー 新宿三丁目駅前店
places.blurb: A real Toyota Rent a Car shop 10 minutes on foot from the hotel. You take the car for 24 hours: the Fuji–Hakone–Daikoku day, then return it on Friday morning.

info.label: Address
info.value: Shinjuku 4-2-18, next to the Koshu-kaido overpass

info.label: Rent
info.value: Thu Jan 21 08:00 → Fri Jan 22 08:00, same shop

info.label: Licence
info.value: Toyota accepts a Geneva IDP + passport and states no minimum years (official FAQ). Aoki's licence is also valid.

info.label: Cost
info.value: Compact, 24 h, ETC card, studless tyres: about ¥15,000–18,000 (estimate, check when you book)

tips: Ask for studless winter tyres (スタッドレスタイヤ) when you book: Tokyo shops have few.
One-way return is possible only inside Tokyo, so this plan brings the car back here.
Tonight park in a 24 h coin car park with a daily maximum (最大料金) near the hotel, about ¥2,000–3,500.

places.blurb: The classic view of Mt Fuji across Lake Kawaguchi. Mornings are the clearest.
tips: It is below zero in the morning. Gloves and a hat.

places.ja: 御殿場プレミアム・アウトレット
places.blurb: A big outlet mall on the east side of Mt Fuji, with Fuji views. Pegasis buys the ski things that cannot be rented here: goggles and ski gloves.

info.label: Buy (rough prices)
info.value: Ski goggles ¥4,000–10,000, waterproof ski gloves ¥3,000–8,000; Aoki the same if needed

tips: Look in the outdoor and sports shops of the outlet (check the shop list on the outlet site the day before).
Ski rental shops in Niseko do not rent goggles or gloves (hygiene rule), so buy them here.
Eat lunch in the food court with a view of Fuji.

places.blurb: A mountain pass on Route 138 between Gotemba and Sengokuhara. The lookout shows Mt Fuji above the Gotemba plain.
tips: Park at the rest house car park, not on the road.

places.blurb: The top of the Hakone Turnpike, 1,011 m, with Lake Ashi and Mt Fuji in one view. You reach it from Sengokuhara, the valley that is Tokyo-3 in Evangelion.

info.label: Winter
info.value: Check @turn819 on X for ice or closure

tips: After the view, drive the Turnpike down to Odawara: 14 km of wide curves. If it is closed for ice, use Route 1.

places.blurb: Japan's largest Chinatown, 20 minutes from Daikoku. Dinner stop before the car meet.
tips: The Cup Noodles Museum closes at 18:00 (last entry 17:00), so it does not fit this day.
Aoki does not like raw fish: Chinatown food is all cooked.

places.blurb: A rest area inside a giant loop of expressway ramps and the most famous JDM car meet in the world. You drive in yourselves, no guide.
tips: If police close the entrance, drive on to Tatsumi PA.
No revving, no burnouts. Ask before you photograph people.

places.blurb: The wide concrete steps on the Tama River from Girls Band Cry episode 2 and the key art.
tips: Buy the Girls Band Cry stamp book at the first stamp spot.
It is windy by the river: warm hat.

places.ja: ラゾーナ川崎プラザ ルーファ広場
places.blurb: The open-air stage in the big mall where the band plays in episode 3. The anime angle is from the 4F and 5F walkways.
tips: No photos of the stage during events: obey the signs.

places.en: Kawasaki East Exit: plaza, Marufuku Coffee, CLUB CITTA'
places.ja: 川崎駅東口 駅前広場
places.blurb: Three Girls Band Cry places within 5 minutes: the station plaza, Marufuku Coffee in the Azalea underground mall, and the CLUB CITTA' live hall in La Cittadella.

info.label: Marufuku Coffee
info.value: 丸福珈琲店 川崎アゼリア店

info.label: CLUB CITTA'
info.value: クラブチッタ, La Cittadella

tips: Have coffee and a hotcake at Marufuku, like the band.

places.blurb: An open roof deck 230 m above the Scramble crossing. Enter before 15:00 for the cheaper ticket and stay until the lights come on.
tips: Web tickets open about 2 weeks ahead (about Jan 8, Japan time). Buy the 14:40 slot.
Before: Hachiko statue (Girls Band Cry ep 3), Nintendo TOKYO and Pokémon Center in Shibuya PARCO, 10 min walk.

places.ja: めいどりーみん 渋谷店
places.blurb: The Shibuya shop of the maid café chain with stage shows, 8 minutes from Shibuya Sky. Dinner with a show after the sunset.

info.label: Hours
info.value: About 11:30–23:00 like the other shops (check the shop page)

info.label: Cost
info.value: ¥880 per hour + one order; about ¥2,000–3,000 with food

tips: Ignore maids handing out flyers on the street; go to the real shop.
A photo with a maid costs extra.

places.ja: コインランドリー 歌舞伎町二丁目店
places.blurb: A 24-hour coin laundry on Shokuan-dori, 150 m from the hotel. Laundry night 1.
tips: Buy detergent-included machines (洗剤自動投入) or a small pack at a konbini.
While it runs: pack the suitcase and send it at the 7-Eleven 100 m away (Yamato 宅急便).

places.blurb: The Tokaido Shinkansen stops here. From Shinjuku it is closer and less crowded than Tokyo Station.
tips: Suitcases over 160 cm total need a seat with oversized baggage space: reserve it.

places.ja: 天然温泉 朝霧の湯 ドーミーインPREMIUMなんばANNEX
places.blurb: A business hotel in Higashi-Shinsaibashi, next to the main Dormy Inn Namba. One base for all 3 Kansai nights: Nara, Kyoto and Suzuka are day trips. Laundry corner on 13F.

info.label: Price
info.value: ¥73,500–84,000 for 3 nights, 2 people (Jalan, vacancy seen Sep 26, 2026) = about ¥37,000–42,000 per person

info.label: Stations
info.value: Nippombashi and Nagahoribashi, a few minutes on foot

tips: Free late-night ramen (夜鳴きそば) 21:30–23:00 for guests.
Kintetsu-Nippombashi (trains to Nara and Suzuka) is about 8 min on foot.
The main Dormy Inn PREMIUM Namba was not on sale for these dates; the ANNEX is its sister hotel on the same block.

places.blurb: Osaka's covered food market: grilled scallops, wagyu skewers, fried things. Many stalls cook the food for you, so it works for Aoki too.
tips: Pick grilled and fried stalls; raw is optional.

places.en: Todai-ji Great Buddha Hall and the Nara Park deer
places.blurb: A huge wooden hall with a 15 m bronze Buddha, at the end of a park with about 1,300 wild deer.
tips: Hold the crackers high until you are ready. Bow to a deer: it bows back.
Hide maps and snacks: the deer eat paper.

places.en: Wakakusa hill burning, view from Kasugano (Nara Park)
places.ja: 奈良春日野国際フォーラム 甍
places.blurb: On Sat Jan 23, 2027: 600 fireworks at 18:15, then the whole grass hill of Wakakusa-yama is set on fire at 18:30. The open ground around the Kasugano forum faces the hill.

info.label: Weather
info.value: Cancelled in bad weather, no second date

tips: Be in place by 17:15. The base of the hill is packed.
Eat an early dinner before 16:45 in the Higashimuki shopping street.

places.blurb: Thousands of red torii gates up a forest hill. At 07:30 there are almost no people.
tips: Walk up to the Yotsutsuji crossing (about 40 min) for the city view, then turn back.

places.blurb: The gold pavilion on a pond. After a night of snow its roof is white, which happens only a few mornings each winter.
tips: Check the Kyoto snow forecast the night before.

places.blurb: The castle tower, with a museum inside and a view over the moats from the 8th floor.
tips: Be at the door at 9:00, before the tour groups.

places.en: Kyoto Station (Sabbat of the Witch meeting place)
places.blurb: The huge glass hall and Grand Stairway of Kyoto Station, where the Sabbat of the Witch characters meet. You meet here at 11:15.

info.label: Meeting point
info.value: Central gate side, under the big glass roof

tips: Climb the Grand Stairway (大階段) for the view from the top.
Pegasis arrives by JR from Osaka, Aoki by bus 205 from Kinkakuji.

places.en: Kyoto Concert Hall (Sabbat of the Witch school)
places.ja: 京都コンサートホール
places.blurb: The modern hall used as the school in Sabbat of the Witch. Outside photos only.
tips: Save the game CGs on your phone to match the angles.

places.blurb: The covered shopping arcade from the Sabbat ramen-challenge scene. Eat a Kyoto ramen lunch nearby.
tips: Keihan Sanjo, 5 min walk, has direct trains back to Osaka.

places.ja: 日本橋でんでんタウン・オタロード
places.blurb: Osaka's Akihabara: Super Potato for retro games, Animate, Melonbooks and used figure shops on one side street.
tips: Used goods are often cheaper than in Akihabara.
Maidreamin and CCOちゃ maid cafés are on Otaroad if you want a second maid café.

places.blurb: Takoyaki and okonomiyaki under the Glico sign, then small standing bars in the Ura-Namba lanes.
tips: In Ura-Namba choose bars that show prices outside.

places.en: Suzuka Circuit (EV kart on the F1 course)
places.blurb: The Japanese F1 Grand Prix track. In the park anyone can drive an EV kart on the real East Course, no licence needed.

info.label: Mon Jan 25
info.value: 10:00–16:30, entry ¥2,000 (official calendar, seen Sep 26, 2026; web tickets about ¥500 less)

info.label: EV kart
info.value: Circuit Challenger on the East Course, about ¥2,000 per kart, web tickets only (Asoview)

info.label: Access
info.value: Kintetsu to Shiroko, then Mie Kotsu bus 20–30 min

tips: The January kart calendar comes out about Dec 1, 2026. Book two karts (one each) in the first slot.
Walk to the grandstand and look at the pit straight.

places.en: Liberty Walk JDM PARK / LB DRIVE-IN
places.blurb: Liberty Walk's showroom of wide-body cars, goods shop and café in Sennan, south of Osaka.
tips: Check the hours on Instagram the day before.
Taxi from Izumisano Station about 15 min; ask the shop to call a taxi back.

places.blurb: The Rapi:t airport train to Kansai Airport starts here.

info.label: Rapi:t
info.value: About 38 min to KIX, ¥1,670 with reserved seat

tips: Buy Rapi:t seats online the day before.

places.blurb: Jetstar to New Chitose leaves from Terminal 1.

info.label: Flight
info.value: Jetstar, Kansai 09:50 → New Chitose 11:50, Tue Jan 26 (Google Flights, Sep 26, 2026: ¥7,510)

tips: Aoki: buy the checked bag when you book (about ¥2,500); later it costs more.
Pegasis: Jetstar allows 7 kg of cabin bags in total. Wear the down jacket and heavy shoes on the plane, or buy a bag too.
Be at the counter by 08:45.

places.blurb: Hokkaido's main airport. You land here on Jan 26 and both fly home from here on Feb 2.

info.label: Rental cars
info.value: Counters in the domestic arrivals hall, shuttle to the shops

tips: Eat lunch at the Hokkaido Ramen Dojo (3F, domestic terminal) before you pick up the car.
Feb 2: Aoki uses the international terminal. Do the tax-free customs check before bag drop.
Feb 2: Pegasis can put the suitcase in a coin locker until the Air Canada counter opens (about 3 h before the flight).

places.en: Toyota Rent a Car New Chitose Airport Poplar
places.ja: トヨタレンタカー 新千歳空港ポプラ店
places.blurb: Check in at the rental counter in the arrivals hall, then a free 9-min shuttle to the shop. Studless tyres are standard in Hokkaido.

info.label: Rent
info.value: Tue Jan 26 about 13:00 → Sat Jan 30 about 14:30, return at Sapporo-ekimae

info.label: Car
info.value: Compact 4WD, studless tyres (standard in Hokkaido), ETC card

tips: Pegasis: licence + IDP + passport. Aoki can drive too.
Ask about the one-way fee to Sapporo-ekimae when you book.

places.blurb: Niseko's biggest rental shop, 100 m from the Grand Hirafu gondola. You both rent everything here: skis, boots, poles, helmet, and ski jacket and pants.

info.label: 3 days, all of it
info.value: About ¥46,000 per person, about ¥41,000 with the online discount

info.label: Not for rent
info.value: Goggles and gloves (buy them at Gotemba)

tips: Book online at least 48 h before: 10% off. You cannot pick brands online; the fitting is in the shop.
Pick-up Tue Jan 26 about 15:15, return Sat Jan 30 about 10:30. Ask when you book if the evening pick-up and next-morning return are free; if not, book 4 days.
Closer option without prices online: Sports Rent Ciao in Nook Annupuri at the Annupuri base.

places.ja: ニセコノーザンリゾート・アンヌプリ
places.blurb: A ski-in, ski-out hotel at the foot of the Annupuri slopes, with a dinner and breakfast buffet of Hokkaido food and big snow views. You sleep here 4 nights: this is the plan's special stay.

info.label: Room
info.value: Deluxe twin, 30 m², own bath and toilet

info.label: Plan
info.value: Winter early-bird 60 (冬期早割60), dinner + breakfast buffet

info.label: Price
info.value: ¥303,808 for 4 nights, 2 people (Jalan, Sep 26, 2026, '1 room left' in this channel) = about ¥37,500 per person per night

info.label: Ski

tips: Book this first: the early-bird 60 plan needs booking 60 days ahead (by about Nov 27), and Niseko is almost full for late January.
The hotel has an onsen and a sauna; nobody has to use them. The room has its own bath.
No coin laundry is listed: laundry night 3 is in Kutchan on Jan 28.
Budget backup (confirmed vacancy): Hotel 3M in Kutchan, ¥72,000 for 3 nights for 2 (only smoking twins were left), room only, 20 min by car to the slopes.

places.ja: ニセコアンヌプリ国際スキー場
places.blurb: The quieter side of Niseko, with wide gentle runs. The best place in Niseko for a beginner, and powder for a good skier.

info.label: Beginner area
info.value: Family course (580 m, max 11°) and Paradise course, from the short Dream No.1 Quad lift (433 m, 4 min)

info.label: Tickets 2026-27 peak
info.value: 1 day ¥7,800, 5 hours ¥6,700, 4-point ticket ¥2,660 (Dream Quad = 1 point a ride)

tips: First hours for Aoki: buy the 4-point ticket (4 rides on the Dream Quad) instead of a day ticket.
Stay on green runs. Do not enter Strawberry Fields or go left off the marked runs.
Check the course map at the base: lifts and courses can change with the snow.

places.ja: ルスツリゾート 雪上ドリフト
places.blurb: A closed snow course with Subaru, GT-R and GR Yaris cars. Ride with a pro rally driver or drive yourself with an instructor beside you.
tips: Check in at the Activity Desk in the Rusutsu Resort Hotel 20 min early. There is a breath test.
Pegasis: email them now to confirm a 1-year licence + IDP is accepted. If not, both take the pro ride.
Warm shoes you can feel the pedals in.

places.ja: ルスツリゾートスキー場
places.blurb: A big ski resort with long groomed runs and far fewer people than Niseko, next to the drift course.
tips: Aoki: stay on the easy runs near the base, or rest in the hotel café.
Leave at 14:30 so the drive and the laundry stop end before dark.

places.ja: コインランドリー（倶知安町北4条東1丁目）
places.blurb: A coin laundry on Route 276 in Kutchan town, on the way back from Rusutsu. Laundry night 3; supermarkets and Seicomart are near.
tips: Buy snacks and drinks for the room in Kutchan: the ski area shops are expensive.

places.ja: ニセコ東急 グラン・ヒラフ
places.blurb: The biggest part of Niseko United, with Mt Yotei across the valley. On Friday Pegasis skis over from Annupuri with the all-mountain ticket.
tips: Only go off-piste through the official gates.

places.blurb: Sapporo's own dish: a thin, spicy curry soup with big chicken and grilled vegetables. One of the most popular shops.
tips: Take a number from the machine at the door, then walk Tanukikoji until your turn.

places.ja: トヨタレンタカー 札幌駅前店
places.blurb: Return the Hokkaido car here, east of JR Sapporo Station, 10 min on foot from the hotel.
tips: Fill the tank first.
One-way fee from New Chitose: check when you book.

places.ja: ホテルルートイン札幌駅前北口
places.romaji: Hoteru Rūto In Sapporo Ekimae Kitaguchi
places.blurb: A good-value business hotel on the north side of Sapporo Station, with a public bath and a free breakfast buffet. Trains to Asahikawa and the airport leave 5 minutes away. You sleep here 3 nights.

info.label: Price
info.value: ¥78,400 for 3 nights, 2 people (Jalan, Sep 26, 2026) = about ¥39,200 per person

tips: Pegasis's suitcase from Tokyo waits here: email the hotel before Jan 22 that a guest parcel will arrive about Jan 25 for a Jan 30 check-in.
Route-Inn hotels usually have a coin laundry: ask at check-in (laundry night 4 is Jan 31).
Susukino and Daruma are 15 min by the Namboku subway line.

places.blurb: A ropeway and mini cable car to a deck with all of Sapporo below. Come for sunset and stay for the lights.
tips: Tram to Ropeway-iriguchi, then the free shuttle bus to the base.

places.ja: 成吉思汗だるま 本店
places.blurb: Sapporo's most famous lamb barbecue since 1954: you grill lamb and onions on a dome-shaped pan at the counter.
tips: There is almost always a queue: be there by 17:45.
Your coats will smell of lamb: they give bags.

places.blurb: JR hub for Asahikawa and the airport.
tips: Reserve the Asahikawa seats at the JR ticket office the day before.

places.blurb: Buses to Asahiyama Zoo leave from bus stop 6 in front of the station.

info.label: Bus to zoo
info.value: Asahikawa Denki Kido bus 41, about 40 min

places.blurb: In winter, king penguins walk a 500 m loop through the snow between the visitors. Also polar bears and a tunnel under the penguin pool.
tips: Stand on the route by 10:40 for a front place.

places.ja: ラーメンの蜂屋 五条創業店
places.blurb: Asahikawa shoyu ramen since 1947, with a pork-and-fish soup and burnt lard on top.
tips: Ask for less burnt lard (少なめ) if you want it milder.

places.ja: 狸小路・まんだらけ札幌店
places.blurb: Sapporo's covered shopping street with Mandarake and other anime goods shops, dry in the snow.
tips: Covered arcade: good on a snowy day.
Buy souvenirs here; the suitcase is in the hotel.

places.ja: めいどりーみん 札幌狸小路店
places.blurb: The same maid show as Akihabara, in the covered Tanukikoji arcade. Open until 23:00.
tips: The last night out: Pegasis's maid café want, Aoki's maybe.

places.ja: 千歳・支笏湖氷濤まつり
places.blurb: Walk-through ice caves and towers made from blue lake water. Opens Jan 30, 2027.

info.label: Bus
info.value: From JR Chitose Station, about 60 min

tips: Check the bus times the day before. If they do not fit, skip it and eat at the airport: the flight is more important.

Pegasis travels with the backpack only; the suitcase is on its way to Sapporo.

In place for fireworks at 18:15 and the fire at 18:30.

alerts: Aoki: leave at 06:30. Check the Kyoto snow forecast the night before (a white Kinkakuji is rare).
Meet at Kyoto Station, central gate, 11:15.

days.title: Return the gear, drive to Sapporo: soup curry, night view, lamb
days.titleJa: ヒラフ（返却）→ 中山峠 → スープカレー → 札幌 → もいわ山 → だるま
days.romaji: Hirafu → Nakayama Tōge → Sapporo → Moiwa-yama → Daruma
days.summary: Return the skis on the way out, then drive over Nakayama Pass in daylight to Sapporo. Soup curry, the car goes back, and you ride up Mt Moiwa for sunset before lamb barbecue at Daruma.
alerts: Check out by 11:00; leave at 10:00.
Nakayama Pass: if it snows hard, take Route 5 to Otaru and the Sasson Expressway instead (2 h 15).

stops.note: Return all rental gear.
Soup curry lunch. Take a number, walk Tanukikoji while you wait.
Return the car with a full tank.
Check in; Pegasis's suitcase from Tokyo is waiting.
Sunset about 16:45, then the city lights.
Jingisukan lamb barbecue. The queue is normal.

legs.label: Road 58 and road 343 to Hirafu
Route 5 to Kutchan, Route 276 to Kimobetsu, Route 230 over Nakayama Pass to central Sapporo
North on Sosei-gawa-dori
Walk under the tracks to the north side
Namboku Line to Susukino, tram to Ropeway-iriguchi, free shuttle bus
Shuttle and tram back to Susukino
Namboku Line, Susukino → Sapporo, walk

days.sleepNote: Hotel Route-Inn Sapporo Ekimae Kitaguchi, night 1 of 3
notes: Your coats will smell of lamb after Daruma: they give bags.
Moiwa ropeway ¥2,100 return.
Tonight Pegasis moves everything from the backpack into the suitcase except 2 days of clothes.
days.cost: ≈ ¥14,000 (fuel, half of the car's last day, food, ropeway)

days.title: Penguin walk at Asahiyama Zoo, Asahikawa ramen
days.titleJa: 札幌駅 → 旭川駅 → 旭山動物園 → 蜂屋 → 札幌
days.romaji: Sapporo Eki → Asahikawa Eki → Asahiyama Dōbutsuen → Hachiya → Sapporo
days.summary: A train day: the limited express to Asahikawa, the 11:00 penguin walk through the snow, and Asahikawa shoyu ramen. Back in Sapporo by late afternoon for rest and the last laundry.
alerts: Reserve the Lilac/Kamui seats the day before.
Warmest clothes today: Asahikawa is the coldest city of the trip.

stops.note: Limited Express Lilac/Kamui about 08:00.
Bus from stop 6.
Penguin walk 11:00. Polar bears and the penguin tunnel.
Asahikawa shoyu ramen.
Rest. Laundry night 4. Evening free near the station.

legs.label: Walk 5 min
JR Limited Express Lilac/Kamui, Sapporo → Asahikawa
Asahikawa Denki Kido bus 41
Bus 41 back toward the station, get off near 5-jo, walk
Walk to Asahikawa Station, JR Limited Express to Sapporo about 15:00, walk

days.sleepNote: Hotel Route-Inn Sapporo Ekimae Kitaguchi, night 2 of 3
notes: The zoo is open 10:30–15:30 in winter; entry ¥1,000.
If the hotel has no washer, ask the front desk for the nearest coin laundry.
Asahiyama counts as the 4th snow day.

days.title: Slow Sapporo day: goods, souvenirs and a maid café
days.titleJa: 狸小路（まんだらけ）→ めいどりーみん 札幌
days.summary: No alarm today. Late breakfast, then goods and souvenirs in the covered Tanukikoji arcade, and a last night out with a maid show.
alerts: Pegasis: weigh the suitcase tonight (23 kg limit is common).
Sapporo Beer Museum is closed on Mondays (both of you said not interested anyway).

stops.note: Mandarake and other goods shops; souvenirs. Lunch in the arcade.
Last night out with a maid show.

legs.label: Namboku Line, Sapporo → Odori, walk
Walk along Tanukikoji
Namboku Line, Susukino → Sapporo, walk

days.sleepNote: Hotel Route-Inn Sapporo Ekimae Kitaguchi, night 3 of 3
notes: Option for Pegasis if he wants one more ski day: Sapporo Teine is 40 min away (not planned).
Aoki: Spring Airlines on Feb 1 was ¥46,950 instead of ¥83,340 on Feb 2 (Google Flights, Sep 26, 2026). If money matters more than this slow day, Aoki can fly home today.

days.title: Fly home from New Chitose
days.titleJa: 札幌駅 → 新千歳空港 → 支笏湖氷濤まつり（Pegasis）
days.romaji: Sapporo Eki → Shin-Chitose Kūkō → Shikotsuko Hyōtō Matsuri
days.summary: You take the airport train together, and Aoki flies home at 13:50. Pegasis has time for the ice festival at Lake Shikotsu before his evening flight to Vancouver and Toronto.
alerts: Aoki: international terminal, check-in opens about 11:00.
Pegasis: suitcase in a coin locker, then check in when Air Canada opens about 16:35.
days.split: From 11:00: Aoki flies home, Pegasis goes to Lake Shikotsu.

stops.note: Rapid Airport train.
Aoki checks in. Spring Airlines 13:50 → Shanghai Pudong 17:00.
Blue ice caves and towers (weekday ¥1,000).
Air Canada 19:35 → Vancouver → Toronto 19:57 same day.

legs.label: Walk 5 min
JR Rapid Airport, Sapporo → New Chitose Airport
JR to Chitose Station, Hokkaido Chuo Bus to Shikotsu-ko
Bus to Chitose Station, JR to the airport

notes: Pegasis's checked bag: see the flight note. Tax-free goods must be shown at customs before bag drop.
If the Shikotsu bus times do not fit, stay at the airport: Snow Miku Sky Town and the Ramen Dojo.
